Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile
Implementation of the Parquet file resource connector for describing the content of a file formatted to the Apache Parquet standard.
